name: Tractor Supply Distribution Center Hagerstown MD

fieldNotes.truckGate: Wide open paved entrance off Hopewell Rd into the yard. Confirmed via Street View (pano e_YUFCIQxiVUzC6xiPUoGA, 2024-10) and z18-z19 satellite: monument sign and flagpole flank an uncontrolled drive, no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point at the property line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth on the truck lane. The red/blue-roofed building beside the entrance is a separate Firestone tire / retail outlet (signage visible in Street View), not a guard shack.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron inside the entrance before the dock doors gives ample internal queue/holding room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Entrance apron and internal yard easily hold a 3+ truck queue before reaching docks.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Wide single open mouth read as ~2 effective inbound lanes; no painted lane control, so approximate.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Approximate; shared open entrance, ~1 outbound lane.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide unmarked entrance apron with abundant paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed in densely along BOTH long building faces (NW/SW face and SE face along I-81); count well into 50+ band. Estimate ~120 doors total, flagged approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer drop yards on the SW/W side (dozens of trailers nose-to-tail, c-w probe) plus a second NW drop block; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on opposite long faces of the building (NW/SW vs SE), consistent with separate ship/receive flows.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial on Hopewell Rd off I-81, surrounded by open fields and farmland; broader setting is Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Industrial corridor along I-81 with adjacent development and good highway access; cellular coverage likely adequate, so false. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus the small separate Firestone/retail building near the entrance.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated on-site trailer-storage lots separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approximate count across all captured drop yards and dock faces.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; I-81 borders the SE side.

citations.claim: Active TSC corporate careers posting for Hagerstown Distribution Center Team Member, ZIP 21740 (matches DC address).

verification.rationale: Official TSC careers names the Hagerstown Distribution Center directly, corroborated by freight directory at 11935 Hopewell Rd; no closure/WARN/construction signals.
